## Gallery Notes

The wall label reads, “Please stand at least 2 meters back”—a rule added after the 2019 renovation.

One curator called the piece “quietly defiant”; another wrote that it “refuses easy categories”—both remarks appear in the catalog, page 14.

Visitors often pause at the note “Oil on panel, c. 1880”—then ask whether the date is approximate or simply unknown.
